thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-91402 triggered by monitor (edge-tls-lb-flip)
PagerDuty: Incident PD-91402 — Critical — sudden TLS handshake failures and LB target flapping in ap-southeast-1. Auto-paging #incidents and current on-call.
arman-b: Acked on-call (arman). Pulling logs.
vera-t: I'm up. Any recent deploy or infra change in APAC?
chloe-p: Not a deploy but we had an auto cert-renew job run ~10m ago in ap-southeast-1. It included a cipher profile tweak.
devops-bot: Alert: LB target unhealthy count increased from 2 to 14 in 3m for pool edge-apac-1.
arman-b: Sample LB log: 
```
2026-03-12T02:14:11Z lb-apac-1: TLS handshake error: alert unexpected_message
2026-03-12T02:14:12Z health-check: target backend-22 returned handshake_failure
```
vera-t: OK, sounds like incompatible cipher/TLS version. Quick probe: `openssl s_client -connect backend-22.ap-southeast-1.internal:443 -servername backend` -> `SSL routines:tls_process_server_certificate:certificate verify failed` — odd. Could be cert chain or SNI mismatch.
chloe-p: The cert-renew pipeline replaced cert chain with new CA-bundle from vendor. It passed canary, auto-promoted after 6m. I'm pausing the pipeline now.
incident-bot: Pipeline pause requested: job cert-renew-apac id=cr-20260312-02 paused.
arman-b: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause promo and revert cert chain at LB level to previous bundle, 2) Shift 60% traffic to us-east-1 for APAC overflow, 3) Cordon & restart nodes with failing healthchecks. Who can shift traffic?
vera-t: I can request traffic shift: `traffic-router shift --region ap-southeast-1 --to us-east-1 --percent 60 --ttl 15m --note "mitigate tls handshake spike"`. Initiating.
devops-bot: Traffic shift request queued. Updating router policy.
PagerDuty: PD-91402 escalated to SRE Lead (vera-t) after auto-escalation timeout (4m).
vera-t: Taking lead. @chloe-p, apply revert to LB cert bundle: `lbctl update-cert --pool edge-apac-1 --cert /secrets/certs/previous/bundle.pem`
chloe-p: Revert applied to primary LB config. Note: a subset of backend proxies still have new chain — need rolling restart. Scheduling restart on those hosts.
arman-b: Running `kubectl get endpoints -n prod | grep backend-22` shows backend-22 in NotReady. Draining backend-22 and backend-25.
chloe-p: Also adding temporary healthcheck tolerance: `lbctl set-health-threshold --pool edge-apac-1 --consecutive-failures 10` to avoid oscillation while we fix nodes.
devops-bot: Router reports traffic 60% shifted to us-east-1. Error spike in ap-southeast-1 reduced from 21% -> 6% within 75s.
vera-t: Good. Support/SE heads: draft a short status page note: "We are investigating TLS errors affecting APAC region. Traffic being rerouted; some customers may see transient errors. No data loss."
arman-b: After rolling restart and cert revert, `openssl s_client` to restarted backends shows full chain and handshake OK. LB target healthy 18/18.
chloe-p: Confirming: final count healthy across pool edge-apac-1 = 19/20. Error rate down to baseline ~0.5%.
vera-t: Keeping traffic shift for 25 more mins for safety, then we'll gradually move back while monitoring.
PagerDuty: PD-91402 status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Auto-close countdown started (30m).
devops-bot: Note: cron job `cert-renew` had an out-of-band CA bundle update. CI accepted it because canary tests only verified expiry, not chain compatibility.
arman-b: Action items for postmortem: 1) Add chain compatibility preflight to cert-renew pipeline (verify intermediates and SNI match), 2) Add auto-rollback window after promotion extended to 15m, 3) Improve healthcheck hysteresis to avoid flapping targets.
vera-t: I'll open incident ticket, attach CI artifacts (cert bundles, canary logs), and assign owners: chloe-p (cert pipeline), arman-b (runbook updates), vera-t (RCA lead).
chloe-p: Will follow up with vendor on CA bundle format.
arman-b: Leaving runbook note: if TLS handshake failures >10% for >4m, trigger automatic 50% traffic shift and pause cert promos.
vera-t: I'll keep monitoring for 40m. Thanks for quick response everyone.
incident-bot: PD-91402 acknowledged by arman-b, vera-t, chloe-p. Incident lead: vera-t.
chloe-p: Publishing 1-paragraph status to status page now.
arman-b: End of thread — monitoring channel for 40m. :thumbsup:
